title: PixelKin - Wild Battle (Dusk Duel)
_note: The default wild-encounter theme (also the attract-mode trailer duel). Regenerated to clearly READ as a battle: urgent and driving but exciting, not scary - the genre's wild-fight energy. snes era for punch and quality, ~152 BPM, 4/4, 16-bar loop (~25s). A minor tension that lifts to a heroic C-major B-section so a random fight still feels winnable. Vesper-motif DNA appears fragmented (the rising leap, restless) per the score's blight/battle treatment. Each loop restarts hard: brass chord stabs + a crash on the downbeat so it kicks like a battle should. Pumping root-fifth bass eighths and a full backbeat carry the adrenaline. Final bar sits on the E dominant to slam back into the A-minor downbeat (seamless loop). Renders on the chip engine for soundtrack cohesion.
key: A minor (tense), lifting to C major (heroic)

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: A (bars 1-8): restless, syncopated A-minor melody, the Vesper leap fragmented and urgent. B (bars 9-16): the line lifts into bright C major - the heroic 'you can win this' answer - then falls to the E dominant to drive the loop back home.

tracks.name: arp
tracks._note: Fast broken-chord arpeggios drive the harmony (the chip-battle shimmer): Am - Am - Am - G - F - C - Dm - E(maj dominant, the G# raising the tension); then the C-major lift: C - F - C - Dm - C - C - G - E back to the top.

tracks.name: stab
tracks._note: Heroic brass chord stabs on accents only - the downbeat punch that makes each loop kick like a battle. Hits at the top, the B-lift, the C-major peak, and a held E-dominant stab into the seam. Silent between (let the lead and groove drive).

tracks.name: drums
tracks._note: A full driving battle backbeat: kick on 1 & 3 plus a push on the 'and of 3', snare on 2 & 4, hats on the eighths. Crash opens the A-minor top and the C-major B-lift; tom fills close each 8-bar half so the loop drives forward. Each bar = 8 eighths.
